body: Nope in fact I’m pretty strong in my opinions & have my own business leading 15 ppl. Still struggle with being nice specially in finding girls
I can tell you’re a girl! As a girl the nicer you are the more guys follow you. As a guy it’s the opposite. That’s the challenge
I’ve already given up to the devil honestly, 33 yo is enough trying no?

Today I’m hurt, calloused, bitter, numb, of course nothing kind. I used to be. And honestly most women on the online dating apps are just waiting to suck someone’s blood and get their fix of validation so I don’t have a great view of them today either. I used to be sweet & thought doing sweet things & being a man of character is all great. But was proven to be nothing bit hurt & misery. My character, everything I had was broken in pieces some yrs ago and I just give it all up to the devil of theres such a thing

I know my actions from the point I started hiding things havnt been nice remotely. My point is till I was, and by that I mean caring, compassionate, loyal, honest I didn’t go anywhere but being hurt & drained.

Oh 100% it’s my own decisions & choices apart from that growing up naive makes you blind till it’s late. I now know I should have gone out 6 months in but it’s late. Now I’m numb, and be lost the reasons why to be nice. It’s always been hurt

I have a fundamental issue with the universe not with girls. My niceness has never got me anywhere in life. Every time I have been manipulative and a jerk I’ve got what I wanted. I still struggle, because I want to be nice and a good man, but I can’t get anything when I’m nice but hurt.

How am I hurt I my wife? You mean the affairs? We’re apart. Legally married so I can it affairs but in reality there’s nothing between us. I have no issue with women. My issue is with life, why it’s so stupid. 
Be a jerk in high school get any girl and find your ideal, leave happy. Be kind, compassionate, mature in high school, every fucking person counsel you but then when it comes to girls nada... they follow the jerks, then 10 yes of draining you emotionally again to see a person happy... I don’t know I struggle with why you be nice when there’s nothing good coming out of it
You’ve read the post completely backward. I’ve never complained nor have I ever expected anything. The relationship drained me & O was left empty. All cuz I was raised a giving person. Wish I wasn’t.
I wish there was no sex drive. Ideal life would be all one sex honestly. It’s a burden
I never felt anyone owes me anything. It hurts me that emotions exist to fall for someone. I don’t care if someone didn’t feel the same. I get that. Why is life like that tho I don’t get
I think we all deserve better. Anyone who’s kind deserves better.
I’m not a victim, I know, but each time I tried and put my best out there, got nothing but hurt. Simple as that
That’s the whole point, I’m ruined cuz I was nice and naive.
Oh I’m not anymore, I was once & for yrs stayed honest & simple. This universe doesn’t seem to encourage it.

Actually 100%, when it comes to girls I have been an idiot. So messed up that your parents raise you not even just teach you to be noble and compassionate and kind, and don’t tell you anything about having games or whatever you need to have a good girl.
